title: Basic Render Pack
positioning: For simple interior visualization needs when the model and direction are already clear.
notes: Final quote depends on scene complexity, modeling needs, number of views, and deadline.

title: Standard Render Pack
positioning: For interior designers and architects who need stronger visual quality and more presentation-ready outputs.
notes: Useful for kitchens, rooms, and residential/commercial interiors.

title: 3D Modeling + Render Pack
positioning: For clients who have 2D plans, sketches, references, or rough concepts and need Arafion to model and render the scene.
notes: Best for clients without a finished 3D model.

title: Premium Sales Pack
positioning: For architects, interior designers, developers, or brands that need cinematic visuals built to sell the project.
notes: Position as commercial visual storytelling, not commodity rendering.

title: Virtual Walkthrough / Web Showcase
positioning: For real estate, architecture, and interior design teams that want project visuals embedded into an interactive website experience.
notes: Use static gallery first if launch speed matters; Three.js viewer can be a phase-two upgrade.

title: MVP / SaaS Sprint
positioning: For founders or companies that need a focused product build with clear scope, milestones, and launchable output.
notes: Do not sell without discovery and scope locking.

title: Dashboard / Internal Tool Build
positioning: For teams that need operational visibility, reporting, admin tools, or workflow control.
notes: Recurring maintenance/support should be offered after launch.

title: Campaign Production & Technical Setup
positioning: For clients that need production quality, campaign infrastructure, reporting, and training rather than only distribution.
notes: Avoid guaranteeing distribution or campaign performance.
